title: Nine Rows of Joining
subtitle: 音乐之声 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 音乐之声（文学艺术与体育·音乐与表演）
meta: 主题语境：音乐之声（文学艺术与体育·音乐与表演）　|　核心词汇：chorus　|　正文 333 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 chorus 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1955 my mother was sent to join ① chorus she could not hear, and she said the joining was the whole of the lesson. The ② chorus, meaning the voices and not the song, was nine rows deep and was joined by whoever came last; chorus, she said, is the only thing in a hall that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ chorus in that hall had the same beat, and the ④ chorus at the end, meaning the one the conductor kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever joined properly. Chorus, my grandmother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the patience is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ chorus was the whole of the evening, meaning the refrain it carried and not the voices. The ⑥ chorus, meaning the refrain and not any of that, is the only thing in an evening that everybody sings and nobody questions; chorus, he said, is either something you join or the only word that means both voices and a refrain. She said the refrain is the part they remember.

By 1970 the ⑦ chorus had become a number in a report, and the report had become an argument about the beat. The ⑧ chorus of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine rows and eleven years of joining; chorus, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ chorus I remember is the one at the end, which was joined in 1975 and is still described as the fullest in the county. A ⑩ chorus, my grandmother said in 1980, is the only thing that improves by being joined; every chorus, she said, is a refrain that has agreed to look like voices. She said the refrain was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 合唱（指那些嗓音本身，与那首歌相对）
C. 固定搭配：join a chorus 加入合唱队
D. n. 合唱（指那座大厅里每一支）
E. n. 合唱（指末尾那一支）
F. n. 副歌（抽象：它承载的那段叠句）
G. n. 那段叠句（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: The chorus, meaning the voices and not the song
chorus was the whole of the evening
the chorus had become a number in a report
The chorus of the whole thing
A chorus, my grandmother said in 1980

answers.why: join a chorus 意为“加入合唱队”，1955 年母亲被派去加入她听不见的那支合唱队。
chorus 意为“合唱、合唱队”，指那些嗓音本身而不是那首歌，共九排，由最后来的人加入。
chorus 指那座大厅里每一支合唱，每一支都是同样的节拍。
chorus 指末尾那一支（指挥留下的那一支），是唯一有人认真加入过的。
chorus 意为“副歌”，抽象指它承载的那段叠句，父亲说 chorus 就是那个晚上的全部。
chorus 为抽象用法，指那段叠句本身，是一个晚上里人人都唱、却没人质疑的东西。
chorus 意为“合唱、合唱队”，到 1970 年这支 chorus 成了报告里的一个数字。
chorus 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九排和十一年的加入。
chorus 意为“合唱”，我记得的是末尾那一支，1975 年加入，至今仍被说成全县最饱满的。
chorus 为抽象总称，祖母说一支合唱是唯一会因为被认真加入而变好的东西。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1955 年母亲被派去加入她听不见的那支合唱队，她说加入才是这堂课的全部。（join a chorus）
那支合唱，指的是那些嗓音本身而不是那首歌，共九排，由最后来的人加入。（chorus）
那座大厅里每一支合唱都是同样的节拍。（chorus）
末尾那支合唱，指的是指挥留下的那一支，是唯一有人认真加入过的。（chorus）
父亲说 chorus 就是那个晚上的全部，指的是它承载的叠句而不是那些嗓音。（chorus）
1980 年祖母说，一支合唱是唯一会因为被认真加入而变好的东西。（chorus）
answers: In 1955 my mother was sent to join chorus she could not hear, and she said the joining was the whole of the lesson.
The chorus, meaning the voices and not the song, was nine rows deep and was joined by whoever came last.
Every chorus in that hall had the same beat.
The chorus at the end, meaning the one the conductor kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever joined properly.
My father said chorus was the whole of the evening, meaning the refrain it carried and not the voices.
